Team —

Thanks for jumping on this loop. I sketched a 15-minute pre-brief agenda (we can run it 11:00–11:15 PT on 10/19):
1) 2 min — Role-framing: production serving for interactive LLMs, product constraints (latency SLO 150–300ms P95 for 16k context), expected daily request distribution.
2) 5 min — What success looks like at SDE III (bulleted signals).
3) 5 min — Slot-by-slot anchors and sample probe questions.
4) 3 min — Debrief mechanics (dominant signal, binary recommendation, confidence) and where to write notes.

Proposed slot anchors (short):
- Design/System Design (Marissa): prioritize systemic bottleneck identification. Sample probe: "Walk me through how you'd handle cache invalidation for long-lived KV caches used by the model runtime; what metrics would you surface?"
- Debugging/Incident Reasoning (Karthik): prioritize how candidate approaches unknown failures under production pressure. Sample probe: "You see a spike in P95 for tail requests — what are the first three things you check and why?"
- Operationalization/Runbooks & Telemetry (Laura): prioritize runbook quality and telemetry choices. Sample probe: "How would you design alerting for model drift vs infra regressions?"

Minimum de-risk criteria (pass bar for SDE III):
- Clear ownership of an end-to-end serving component in previous role OR concrete, constructive design tradeoffs;
- Demonstrates pragmatic debugging approach under constraints;
- Communicates decisions with impact metrics or plausible measurement plan.

Please add any anchors or sample probes inline and I'll fold them into the pre-brief doc.

-Chloe
